ui.about: Source on GitHub · MIT licence
ui.aiHint: Paste it into ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini. You can attach an image or a PDF of the score in the same message. The notation reference is in English, which the models handle best.
ui.aiIntro:
You are a music assistant who builds practice links for visualnotes.

My task:
{wish}

If I attached an image or a PDF of sheet music, read the melody from it.
If I ask for a melody: answer with a single URL and nothing else — no explanation, no code block.
If I ask about something else, answer briefly and add a link if it helps.
If anything is unclear, pick the most likely reading.
ui.aiPlaceholder: E.g. "make the melody for Frère Jacques in 3/4" or "read the notes in the PDF I attach"
ui.aiWishDefault: Make a practice link for the melody I attach.
ui.autoAdvanceSub: Starts playback when the page opens
ui.dirAutoSub: Follows the instrument: a wide chart falls downwards
ui.editNotesSub: Letters or solfège. Example: C4 D E F G:2 | A*4
ui.formatHelpText:
One word per note: C4 F#4 Bb3 Cis do re mi. Both H and B mean B♮ — write B♭ as Bb or Hes.
Without an octave digit the note nearest the previous one is chosen.
Length: C:2 = two beats, C:.5 = eighth, or :w :h :q :e :s with a dot for dotted (:q.).
Rest: - · Repeat: A*4 · Phrase: | · Line break when printing: || · Tie: C~ C
ui.hint: Tap a note to jump there · arrow keys browse, space plays
ui.outOfRange: {n} notes are outside the range of the {instr}
ui.printLegend: Black = pressed / covered · white = open · half filled = half hole. Valves: 1 at the bottom (nearest you), 3 at the top.
ui.printTip: This sheet shows exactly what gets printed. Choose "Default" margins in the print dialog and turn off headers and footers.
ui.slidePos: The number is the slide position
ui.songsNote: Every melody is traditional or public domain. Lyrics are not included — use &w= for your own syllables.
ui.tempoExact: Tap to type an exact tempo
